verdict.summary_en: Boise Semiconductor order acknowledgement OA26254278 for Soony Interactive GmbH's PO 4500318714 (dated 2026-08-14). It confirms one line: 8,500 pcs of CMP-GAM-002 (Game Card 64 GB – Grand Heist 5) at 6.11 USD each, confirmed for 2026-09-16. The terms are EXW Boise with NET30 payment. The document has no handwritten corrections or stamps. Its delivery-terms text is internally inconsistent.
red_flags: Delivery terms contradict each other: the document states EXW Boise and says DDP is not agreed, but also says freight, insurance and duties are prepaid by Seller and added to the invoice. Under EXW the buyer normally arranges and pays for freight, so the buyer should clarify who bears these costs and whether they will be invoiced.
No total price is stated, and no ordered quantity is shown to compare with the confirmed 8,500.
The document has no date of its own; 2026-08-14 is the buyer's order date.
observations: Clean, typed single-page PDF with no handwriting, stamps, signatures or overwrites.
The description wraps over three lines in the table (Game Card 64 / GB – Grand / Heist 5).
The column headed 'Qty' is read as the confirmed quantity because the document carries a 'Confirmed' date column and is an order acknowledgement. The document does not label it explicitly.
